rationale: Unspecified public SCF and stationary-force tiles resolve independently from hardware capability, fitted restricted strict-FP64 gradient-dependent work and grid size. Eligible full-rate FP64 SCF owners use 1024 (nonlocal 512); eligible all-electron through-d native force owners on compute capability 8 or newer use 1024 for 48–128 atoms. Explicit sizes, scientific controls and bounded 256-point fallbacks remain authoritative. Complete default-path qualification is required before promotion.
